provenance.notes: Public elementary schools (amenity=school named …小学校) and childcare (amenity=kindergarten|childcare) inside the catalog boundaries of 越谷市 and 草加市. Records follow ReferencePlaceRecord. OSM tags 幼稚園, 認定こども園 and 保育園 alike, so facilityType comes from the name: 幼稚園 = kindergarten, こども園 = kodomoen, otherwise hoikuen. Checked against the cities' own lists: the 29 越谷市立 and 21 草加市立 elementary schools, all 18 越谷 and 15 草加 private kindergartens, and the 認定こども園 of both cities are covered. 越谷市立蒲生第二小学校, which OSM still maps, merged into 蒲生小学校 on 2022-04-01 and is saved as retired; しらとり保育園 is しらとりこども園 on 越谷市's list, and わかばの森ナーサリー (not in OSM) is added from that list at its GSI-geocoded address. A facility OSM maps as both a node and a way is kept once.
provenance.names: nameEn is the reading in Hepburn without macrons plus the kind in English (Elementary School, Kindergarten, Nursery, Kodomoen); `reading` is the kana it was made from. School readings agree with 越谷市's school pages (all 29) and, for 草加市, with the city's and prefecture's pages (6 schools) or マピオン電話帳 (15). Childcare readings are the kana of the name itself or the place name it carries; 越谷市's 保育所 readings were checked against the city's guide. A name with a part of unknown reading has no nameEn.

schoolDetails.fields: address, postalCode, phone, website, pupils/pupilsYear, specialSupportClass/specialSupportKinds (特別支援学級), resourceRoom (通級指導教室), japaneseSupport/japaneseSupportEn (the city's scheme), note/noteEn, detailSource
schoolDetails.japaneseLanguageClass: Not set for any school: neither city publishes which schools host a 日本語指導教室 or have 日本語指導 加配 teachers. 越谷市 dispatches 日本語指導員 to a pupil's school on request (33 schools and 85 pupils in 令和5年度); 草加市 runs one central room, SOKAいっぽ, and places 8 国際理解教育補助員 at the schools the pupils attend.
schoolDetails.caveats: Pupil counts are as of 2025-05-01 (越谷市) and 2026-05-01 (草加市). 草加市's special-support kinds come from the prefecture's 令和7年度 list. 蒲生小学校 has used a new building at the same site since September 2026; its address is the city's listed one.
